summary: Treat docs/plate/wiki/Goals.md as the Goals page when PLATE docs are namespaced.
migration_impact: No adopter file move. Repositories that already keep Goals at docs/plate/wiki/Goals.md pass gh plate self-migrate --verify after upgrading plate-core. Flat checkouts that still use docs/wiki/Goals.md are unchanged.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core to the release that includes this fix.
2. Re-run gh plate self-migrate --verify in the adopter checkout.
3. Leave docs/plate/wiki/Goals.md in place. Do not copy it back to docs/wiki/Goals.md.
agent_notes: Adoption core_ready, self-migrate refresh paths, health goals_page_present, and the information audit Goals fetch accept docs/wiki/Goals.md and docs/plate/wiki/Goals.md. When docs/plate/ exists and neither file is present, the missing path reported to the operator is docs/plate/wiki/Goals.md.
